title: not-uber-service - live
description: What the platform is doing right now: trips finishing, position events arriving, where demand is, and how often the route prediction was wrong. Every panel reads the Distributed tables, so it sees both shards.

panels.title: Trips completed (last hour)
panels.description: Counted from the hourly summary table, which is filled automatically as trip events arrive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(completed_trips) AS trips FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Revenue (last hour)
panels.description: Final fares of completed trips, surge included.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Trips slower than predicted (24h)
panels.description: How often the real trip took longer than the route calculation promised. A number that climbs means the traffic factors are out of date.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * sum(overrun_trips) / greatest(sum(completed_trips), 1) AS pct FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Average surge (last hour)
panels.description: Surge added up divided by the number of trips. 1.0 means normal price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(surge_sum) / greatest(sum(completed_trips), 1) AS avg_surge FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Position events per minute
panels.description: Driver and rider position reports arriving in ClickHouse. This is the best single sign that the pipeline is alive end to end.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, 'drivers' AS series, count() AS events FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, 'riders' AS series, count() AS events FROM nus.rider_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Busiest zones right now
panels.description: The newest demand score per zone. This is the same number that sets the surge price for trips starting there.

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone_id, argMax(demand_score, computed_at) AS demand, argMax(open_requests, computed_at) AS waiting_riders, argMax(available_drivers, computed_at) AS free_drivers, argMax(surge_multiplier, computed_at) AS surge FROM nus.hotspot_history WHERE computed_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY zone_id ORDER BY demand DESC LIMIT 10
